parts: Jch.pt. Big-Foot de Thalek Lucky Break
Male white and gold born on 27 of October of 2011.
From the cross of our latest import, Feel The Angel (Dandy), with our female Clear Spring (Yazmine), daughter of our Champion Amistad Sincera (Miss), this beautiful dog was born.
She is now living with our friend Jessica and her furry companions in A Coruña. We are grateful for the trust she has placed in us, our dogs and our breeding.
We hope and wish her a successful show career.
